name.en: Keiichi Shibahara Fund overseas study support program for medical students
name.ja: 柴原慶一基金医学部学生海外留学支援プログラム

audience.en: Nagoya University medical students in four overseas programs
audience.ja: 四つの海外プログラムに参加する医学部の学生

duration.en: Up to 6 months (basic medical seminar), up to 3 months (the two elective clerkships); entrepreneurship: short or long
duration.ja: 基礎医学セミナーは最長6か月、二つの選択臨床実習は最長3か月。起業家養成は短期と長期

capacity.en: Basic medical seminar 2, basic-science placement 2, clinical clerkship 12, entrepreneurship 4 students a year (as stated)
capacity.ja: 基礎医学セミナー2名、基礎系配属2名、海外臨床実習12名、起業家養成4名（年間、旧サイトの記載）

funding.en: JPY 3 million, 1.5 million and 1.5 million for the first three programs; up to 3 million (short) or 8 million (long) for entrepreneurship. Adjusted by destination and period.
funding.ja: 最初の三つは300万円、150万円、150万円。起業家養成は短期最大300万円、長期最大800万円。派遣先と期間により調整

howToApply.en: Details are announced on TACT, and briefings are held from time to time. Contact the study-abroad program staff of the office.
howToApply.ja: 詳細はTACTで案内します。説明会も随時あります。国際連携室の海外留学プログラム担当に問い合わせてください

text.en: Next call: not announced. Calls are posted on TACT; ask the office when the next one is expected.
text.ja: 次回の募集は未定です。募集はTACTで案内されます。次の募集の時期は国際連携室に確認してください

toConfirm: Number of recipients for the basic medical seminar: 2 a year on the fund page, 4 names in the 2024 list.
